home.descriptionLine1: Diagnostic tools and evidence-based content for radiologists —
home.descriptionLine2: from structured RADS scoring to AI research. Built by a radiologist, for radiologists.
home.whatWeBuildSub: Tools and content that bridge the gap between AI research and clinical practice.
home.radsDesc: Unified calculator for TI-RADS, BI-RADS, Lung-RADS, and LI-RADS. Structured radiology reporting with evidence-based recommendations — one tool for all scoring systems.
home.scrubcodeDesc: YouTube channel breaking down Medical AI papers and deep learning concepts. Foundations, hot takes, and vibe coding — for clinicians who want to understand the technology.
home.medglowDesc: Evidence-based skincare meets dermatology science. YouTube content with a medical lens on the beauty industry — separating marketing claims from clinical evidence.
home.followSub: Medical AI insights, paper breakdowns, and tool updates — from a radiologist who builds.

about.title: The Team Behind Aperivue
about.bio1: Neuroradiology Fellow at Asan Medical Center, University of Ulsan College of Medicine. Research focus on diagnostic accuracy studies, medical image analysis with deep learning, and AI validation in clinical workflows.
about.bio2: KAIST (B.S. in Biological Sciences), Yonsei University College of Medicine (M.D.), and MI2RL (Medical Imaging & Intelligent Reality Lab) at Asan Medical Center. Creator of MedSci Skills — an open-source toolkit (MIT, github.com/Aperivue/medsci-skills) that automates medical manuscript writing and quality assurance.
about.missionText: Aperivue aims to make radiology smarter and more accessible. We build practical tools that help radiologists work more efficiently — from structured RADS scoring calculators to AI-assisted diagnostic pipelines. Our content bridges the gap between cutting-edge AI research and everyday clinical practice.
about.contactSub: Have questions or want to collaborate? Reach out below.

skills.title: Medical Research Skills for Claude Code
skills.description: {count} skills covering the full research lifecycle — from literature search to manuscript revision. Built by physicians, battle-tested on real publications. MIT licensed.
skills.introVideoSubtitle: From idea to submission — what MedSci Skills does, in two minutes.
skills.demoDesc: 3 end-to-end demos across 3 study types — diagnostic accuracy (Wisconsin BC), meta-analysis (BCG vaccine, 13 RCTs), and epidemiology (NHANES 2017-18). Each produces a complete manuscript, 300 dpi figures, reporting compliance audit (STARD / PRISMA / STROBE), and a presentation — from public data only.
skills.installDesc: Copy skills to your Claude Code skills directory. That's it.
skills.desktopDesc: No programming experience? Use the Desktop app instead of the CLI. Download ZIP from GitHub, copy the skills folder — done.
skills.requires: Requires Claude Code Desktop or CLI. Python 3.9+ for statistical analysis and figure generation.
skills.impactSubtitle: Stars, forks, and citable DOI-pinned releases — adoption is tracked publicly on GitHub and Zenodo.

products.title: Our Products
products.description: Free, open-source tools built for radiologists and medical researchers.

lectures.title: Lectures & Workshops
lectures.description: Hands-on workshops that help physicians use AI in their own practice and research. Run by a radiologist who codes.
lectures.learn1Title: Build tools for your own workflow
lectures.learn1Desc: From scheduling helpers to report templates — turn daily frustrations into working software in a few hours.
lectures.learn2Desc: Dataset → statistics → figures → manuscript draft → reporting checklist — one pipeline demonstrated with medsci-skills.
lectures.learn3Title: Find research gaps in your own data
lectures.learn3Desc: Feed your institution's data dictionary and let AI suggest research questions grounded in existing literature.
lectures.formatDesc: 2–3 hour hands-on. Each participant brings a laptop. Claude Pro + Claude Desktop required. Pre-survey and OS-specific install guide sent 1 week in advance to minimize setup friction.
lectures.proposeTitle: Host a Lecture at Your Institution
lectures.proposeDesc: Open to invitations from hospitals, academic societies, and departments. We've run lectures for radiology, surgery, and general clinical audiences.
